summary: An Insubstantial player within 20' must return to base, their Insubstantial State replaced by Banish's, ending it on arrival.

effects.subject: target
effects.note: Must return to their base while Insubstantial from Banish (N1). A Forced Movement effect. When cast on another player; the self-cast case is e2.

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: When cast on self (the caster must already be Insubstantial): the caster travels to their base (Forced Movement) and may end the Insubstantial State at any time with the Insubstantial exit incantation (N3).

termination.note: Upon arrival they must immediately end the effect as per Insubstantial.
If the Insubstantial State ends before reaching the base, the rest of the effect ends as well.
Only when Banish is cast on self: the caster may end the Insubstantial State at any time with the Insubstantial exit incantation.

references.name: insubstantial
references.note: Target must be Insubstantial; that State is replaced by a new Insubstantial State from Banish.

clarifications.text: The target's existing Insubstantial State is replaced with a new Insubstantial State from Banish, so the State is now governed by Banish.

open_questions: Convention 10 encodes Banish only as move.to-base; N1's replacement Insubstantial State is kept as a clarification rather than a state.apply effect.
Beneficiary 'any': normally used on enemies, but N3 explicitly allows casting it on self (a quick return to base).
